title: CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #3 BATTLEPLAN EXTINGUISHED SINS OPEN
lines: 01 CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #3 BATTLEPLAN EXTINGUISHED SINS OPEN

SEASON DETAILS: During the season, players can combine different "Criteria" in the Main Test Site and the Rotating Test Sites to clear stages. By completing tests, players can increase their Sanctuary Judgment scores and collect "Crystal Contract Bounty" (can be used to redeem rewards in the Crystallization Sanctuary). Upon completing certain "Objective Sets," players can also earn rewards such as the exclusive outfit for Quartz , Integrated Module Data Chunks, and season furniture.
DETAILS: During the event, players can collect "Crystal Contract Bounty". Consume "Crystal Contract Bounty" to redeem rewards in the Crystallization Sanctuary.
MAIN REWARDS: Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Parts, etc.
02 TARGETED OPERATOR HEADHUNTING OPEN: JOINT OPERATION
DETAILS: During the event, the Targeted Operator Headhunting, [Joint Operation], opens, and ONLY the following Operators will appear in the 6★ and 5★ Operator List of this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★: Cantabile / Firewhistle / Bobbing / Lucilla / Sand Reckoner / Mulberry
DETAILS: All stages in Supplies and Chips stay open during the period above.
Please stay tuned for more information!
